name: Business events selector when publishing events from Notebook
description: **Business Events Selection from Notebook to Create Dynamic Publishing Code****Overview**Enable users to select Business Events directly from within Notebooks and automatically generate publishing code—bridging schema discovery with code-first development in a seamless, guided workflow.**Key Capabilities*** Inline Business Events Selection in Notebook: Browse and select Business Events schemas directly from within the Notebook environment, without switching context.* Dynamic Code Generation: Automatically generate publishing code based on the selected Business Event schema—reducing manual setup and errors.* Schema-Driven Development Experience: Ensure generated code aligns with standardized Business Event definitions, enforcing consistency across publishers.* Pre-configured Publishing Logic: Provide ready-to-run code templates for emitting Business Events, including connection setup and payload structure.* Seamless Edit-and-Run Workflow: Allow users to customize, test, and execute event publishing logic interactively within the Notebook.

result.nameEs: Selector de Business Events al publicar eventos desde un notebook
result.descriptionEs: Podrás seleccionar Business Events desde el propio notebook y generar automáticamente el código para publicarlos, alineado con el esquema estándar del evento y con la conexión y la estructura del mensaje ya preparadas, para editarlo, probarlo y ejecutarlo de forma interactiva.
